Bank pool management, copy-on-write field access, root advancement, and stake delegation updates.

# Purpose
This C file implements the core management logic for `fd_banks_t`, which is the shared-memory container for a tree of `fd_bank_t` objects. It provides the size and alignment helpers, creation and join functions for the `fd_banks_t` region, and delete and leave functions for the shared memory object. The code also sets up the internal pools used by banks, including the main bank pool, the cost tracker pool, and the copy-on-write pools for fields that use CoW storage. The `FD_BANKS_ITER` macro drives generation of field-specific accessors and lock wrappers, so the file defines the public API for reading, modifying, and copying bank state in a uniform way.

The file also manages bank life cycle and tree state. It creates new banks, clones banks from a parent, clears banks, advances the root bank, marks banks dead or frozen, and validates pool usage. It also handles stake delegation state by applying deltas from a bank and its ancestors into the root or frontier state. Locking is used throughout to protect shared state, and the code enforces tree and pool invariants with runtime checks.
